prompt.main_subject: Two adults appear in a workplace comedy: a Gen-Z worker with a backpack and an adult boss/HR colleague holding two documents.
prompt.composition_elements: Two-scene office sketch: after-hours ownership speech and next-morning pajama role reversal with desk, foot basin, cartoons, and sunflower seeds.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Slightly dim dusk office in scene one, then ordinary office lighting and exaggerated comedy reactions in scene two.

technical_specs.camera: Close-ups for dialogue and wide shots for office reversal.
technical_specs.motion: Block path, hand over documents, next-day door reveal, lazy workstation reaction.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a realistic high-definition workplace reversal comedy with two adults in frame. In scene one, an adult Gen-Z worker wearing a backpack prepares to clock off in the company office while an adult boss/HR colleague holding two thick documents blocks his path and gives an ownership speech. He repeats the idea, accepts the documents, and says he is enlightened. The next morning, the worker arrives in extremely casual silk pajamas and plastic slippers, treating the office as his home; the adult boss/HR colleague opens the door and freezes in shock. Show the desk pushed aside, a red foot basin, cartoons on a computer, and sunflower seeds. The worker lazily asks why she is staring and tells her to sweep, then the comedy ends with exaggerated hip-hop or Thug Life music. Keep both characters adult and frame the speech as satirical workplace commentary, not coercive instruction.
prompt.negative_prompt: coercion, harassment, workplace abuse endorsement, graphic violence, minor, blurry, watermark, text, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The single supplied composite image visibly contains both office characters, so it is attached to both required roles. Preserve their adult presentation, documents, office setting, and role-reversal joke; wardrobe changes are the source-supported next-morning gag.
